# Unity Foundation

> A modern, multilingual NGO website supporting children, people with disabilities, and people experiencing poverty in Denmark.

## Overview

Unity Foundation is built with Next.js 14 (App Router) and provides:
- Multilingual support: English, Danish, Persian (RTL)
- Admin CMS for managing posts and announcements
- MobilePay donation integration
- Cloudinary image hosting
- NextAuth authentication with role-based access

## Key Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/unity-foundation)

## Tech Stack

- Framework: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript
- Database: PostgreSQL + Prisma ORM
- Auth: NextAuth.js
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- i18n: next-intl
- Testing: Playwright (E2E)
